items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley (hamstring) did not practice again Thursday, consecutive DNPs; week-to-week and unlikely for Week 5 vs JAX in London. Eagles signed Dameon Pierce; Will Shipley expected to lead backfield.
items.why: Consecutive DNPs post-Week 4 exit; Rapoport earlier week-to-week.
items.implication: Sit Barkley; elevated volume for PHI backups in London.
items.opportunity: Lead back role for Shipley/Pierce with Bigsby IR.

items.text: Eagles WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring) did not practice again Thursday alongside Barkley.
items.implication: Further depletes PHI pass catchers; Hurts/Wicks/others impacted.
items.opportunity: Increased targets for remaining WRs/TE if out.

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson did not practice Thursday due to ankle; Friday practice looms large for Sunday Night availability vs ATL.
items.why: Ankle injury; consecutive DNPs, MRI context earlier.
items.implication: Monitor Friday closely; Huntley backup if sits.
items.opportunity: Ravens skill upside variance if Lamar limited/out.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey no practice again Thursday (foot); week-to-week after Week 4 aggravation.
items.why: Foot injury, consecutive DNPs; Harbaugh week-to-week.
items.implication: Major target loss for Herbert if out vs DEN.
items.opportunity: Boost to Quentin Johnston/others in LAC pass game.

items.text: Broncos HC Sean Payton taking play-calling duties from OC Davis Webb starting Week 5 vs LAC.
items.why: Confirmed by Payton after sluggish 2-2 start; instincts decision.
items.opportunity: Increased efficiency/scheme familiarity for DEN skill players.

items.text: Matthew Berry LOVES Nico Collins vs Titans; ranks him WR8.
items.why: Strong matchup and volume; part of Love/Hate and 10 Facts.
items.opportunity: High target share vs vulnerable TEN secondary.

items.text: Berry LOVES Chase Brown (RB5 @ MIA), Aaron Jones (@ NO RB8), Jaylen Warren (RB12 if Dowdle out).
items.why: Workload + defenses carved by RBs; Brown ties to CIN WR injuries.
items.opportunity: Brown volume upside; Warren lead if Dowdle sits.
items.conflict: Levitan notes Chase Brown under xFP.

items.text: Steelers WR Michael Pittman Jr. aggravated foot (plantar fasciitis) and will miss multiple weeks per coach.
items.implication: Extended absence; PIT WR depth chart shifts.
items.opportunity: Elevated role for DK Metcalf and other Steelers receivers.

items.text: ETR/Levitan: 'Will Shipley show' expected vs JAX with Barkley/Bigsby out; elevated PHI RB discussion post-injuries.
items.why: Barkley week-to-week, Bigsby IR; Shipley last man + Pierce signed.
items.implication: Waiver/start Shipley as volume play in tough matchup.

items.text: Bijan Robinson and Kyren Williams performing well above expected fantasy points on opportunities; Ashton Jeanty and Chase Brown underperforming theirs (xFP data).
items.why: Sortable ETR xFP: overperformers efficient; under on volume/efficiency.
items.implication: Sustain Bijan/Kyren; fade or buy-low Jeanty/Chase Brown if opportunity holds.
items.opportunity: High-efficiency backs retain value; monitor role for underperformers.

items.text: Titans WR Carnell Tate limited Thursday with back injury.
items.implication: Monitor; recent high target/air yards share at risk.
items.opportunity: If limited/out, Titans other WRs rise.

items.text: Berry LOVES Michael Wilson (WR10 vs DET), Christian Watson (WR15 vs CHI), Isaiah Likely (TE5 @ WSH).
items.why: Volume/red-zone + soft matchups per Love/Hate recap.
items.opportunity: Wilson high targets vs DET; Watson/Likely scheme/matchup edges.

items.text: First Week 5 projections live; DET-ARZ one of most popular DFS stacks ever due to 54.5 total and pricing (no other game over 45.5).
items.why: Slate context + high total drives stack popularity.
items.implication: Prioritize DET/ARI skill in DFS/season-long if matching.
items.opportunity: High-scoring environment boosts Gibbs/St. Brown/MHJ/McBride etc.

items.text: Berry 10 Facts: Kyren 76% snaps/out-touched Corum heavily + receiving; Carnell Tate 43% target share/73% air yards; Kincaid target share dipped to 9% recent.
items.implication: Kyren locked-in; Tate rising; Kincaid monitor dip but still believer.
items.opportunity: Kyren workhorse; Tate WR upside; Kincaid rebound potential.
